summary: Sandbach United got their 2026/27 season off to a winning start with a 1-0 home victory over Stafford Town, with Stan Tatters scoring the decisive goal in the first half. The Bach had to work hard for the three points against a resilient opponent but secured a clean sheet to cap off a battling performance. The opening day success gives the squad plenty of momentum as they look to build on this solid foundation in the campaign ahead.
